summary: YouTube is testing new Shorts rewards that include affiliate bonuses for creators.
Malwarebytes flagged a fake Amazon Music offer being sent to YouTube creators to steal their Google sign-ins.
Draft2Digital ran a session on moving books out of Kindle Unlimited exclusivity and selling on more stores.
LTK is promoting a Q4 holiday playbook event for brands, and Later posted creator partnership and TikTok videos.
Lasso, URLgenius, Button/Posttap and Amazon's own tools had no relevant news (Amazon's only posts were about Prime Video).

items.title: YouTube Tests New Shorts Incentives & Affiliate Bonuses
items.why: YouTube is testing extra rewards for Shorts, including affiliate bonuses. More pay tied to product links in short videos means more creators sharing links from YouTube.

items.title: Amazon YouTube creator phishing: fake Music offer
items.why: Scammers are sending YouTube creators fake Amazon Music offers to steal their Google logins. A reminder that creators get a lot of fake brand deal emails.

items.title: pinning a comment with a link to your latest upload helps direct your viewers exactly where you want them to go next. it's an easy way to promote your other long form content.
Beyond KU: How to Transition Beyond Amazon Exclusivity
items.why: Draft2Digital is coaching authors on leaving Kindle Unlimited exclusivity and selling on more stores, which means more authors needing links that work across every store.
